description_en: Alibaba Cloud Model Studio lightweight application — Enables in-vehicle systems and content platforms to interact with news hot topics — Broadcast list (hot topics) Q&A: Ask questions about broadcast lists, news, and open-domain content
description_zh: 阿里云百炼轻应用-车机/内容平台新闻热榜互动-播报单（热榜）问答：可以对播报单、新闻、开放域内容问答
kebab_example: aliyun quanmiaolightapp run-hot-topic-chat --workspace-id llm-xx --model-id qwen-max-latest --model-custom-prompt-template xx --generate-options newsChatGenerate --task-id a3d1c2ac-f086-4a21-9069-f5631542f5a2 --original-session-id a3d1c2ac-f086-4a21-9069-f5631542f5ax --prompt '帮我播报体育热点' --hot-topic-version 2024-09-13_12 --category '体育' --hot-topics xxx --image-count 1 --step-for-broadcast-content-config '{"customHotValueWeights":[{"weight":1,"dimension":"comments"}],"topicCount":20,"categories":["体育"]}' --messages role=user createTime=2024-12-10_18:51:29 content=xxx --region cn-hangzhou
